events.detail: The trusted matrix audit returned byte-valued evidence; direct JSON encoding rejected bytes. No matrix was accepted on this error. Added deterministic typed hex/decimal/set serialization without changing checks or status decisions.

X05 reference adaptation uses the existing reservation primitive at a fixed-key scope rather than deriving the next value outside that primitive. This preserves reservation-before-encryption, exhaustion and restart semantics. No scientific criterion or constructor attempt changed.

Seven isolated-worker/meta-test calls failed with TypeError because timeout_seconds was passed positionally to the original keyword-only run_bounded API. Corrected the call syntax; deadlines and criteria are unchanged.

X28 raw storage paging must not eagerly impose the approximate prefilter's encoding on keys previously handled by exact-mode storage. Preserve raw keys with separate storage addressing and keep the original prefilter encoding behavior. Added direct old/new transition/error comparisons, including non-ASCII exact-mode keys, and exhaustive X23 group/failure combinations. No specification or criterion changed.

events.stage: corrected worker and exhaustive interface checks
events.detail: Includes both interface worker matrices, spoof/crash/import/deadline checks, complete group/failure combinations and storage transitions in both precision modes.
